description: Defines the VASurface class used for VA-API video decoding, including reference counting, surface properties, and release callback mechanisms.

classes.name: VASurface
classes.description: A reference-counted class representing a VA-API decode surface with properties like size and format, and a callback for release.

methods.name: VASurface
methods.description: Constructor initializing a VASurface with surface ID, size, format, and release callback.

methods.name: id
methods.description: Returns the VASurfaceID of the surface.

methods.description: Returns the size of the surface.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Returns the format of the surface.
